aggregation: exact duplicate vectors with occurrence-count weights
pipe_units_assumed: capacity kW; fixed loss kW/m; initial cost EUR/m
pipe_cost_basis_assumed: initial investment annualised at 5% over 30 years
pipe_direction: fork-to-fork pipes may reverse hourly; terminal pipes are directed
pipe_type_requirement: at least one installed DN-30 and one installed DN-50
losses: installed pipes have constant losses in every model hour
calendar_index: 2025-01-01 is an arbitrary non-leap model index, not a source-year claim
